newsitem.title: USA: Three IBP beef plants closed Monday for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Three IBP beef plants closed Monday for holiday.

text.p: IBP Inc said three of its 12 fed cattle slaughter and beef plants will be closed Monday in observance of the U.S. Veteran's Day holiday, said an IBP spokesman.
The three plants are in Amarillo, Texas; Emporia, Kan.; and West Point, Neb.
All of IBP's hog and pork plants will operate Monday, the spokesman said.

Early Thursday, Hormel Foods Corp said its Austin, Minn., pork processing plant and Fremont, Neb., hog slaughter plant will be closed Monday for the holiday. Also closed Monday will be Quality Pork Processing Inc's hog slaughtering plant in Austin, which provides fresh pork for Hormel's Austin plant, a Quality Pork company official said.
Officials from other U.S. beef and pork companies were unavailable to comment regarding Monday operations.
